reference_sql:
WITH start_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account with an event by the end of 2024
  SELECT e.account_id, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id
), end_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account with an event by the end of 2025
  SELECT e.account_id, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(n.mrr, 0)) / SUM(o.mrr), 1) AS nrr_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(n.mrr, 0), o.mrr)) / SUM(o.mrr), 1) AS grr_pct
FROM start_mrr o
LEFT JOIN end_mrr n ON n.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE o.mrr > 0

WITH acct AS (
  -- one row per account, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id,
    SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31') AS mrr_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FILTER (WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'), 0) AS mrr_2025
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(mrr_2025) / SUM(mrr_2024), 1) AS nrr_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_2025 < mrr_2024 THEN mrr_2025 ELSE mrr_2024 END) / SUM(mrr_2024), 1) AS grr_pct
FROM acct
WHERE mrr_2024 > 0

  GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(mrr_2025) / SUM(mrr_2024), 1) AS nrr_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_2025 < mrr_2024 THEN mrr_2025 ELSE mrr_2024 END) / SUM(mrr_2024), 1) AS grr_pct

other_way.tradeoff: One pass with FILTER gives each account's two balances side by side, and the cohort is then a plain WHERE.

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (SELECT e.account_id, a.segment, e.event_type, e.event_date, s.currency, e.mrr_delta_local AS d, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS eur
  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT account_id, COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'), 0) AS m24, COALESCE(SUM(eur) FILTER (WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'), 0) AS m25 FROM ev GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m25) / SUM(m24), 1) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(m25, m24)) / SUM(m24), 1) AS grr_pct FROM a WHERE m24 > 0
